description:
Use this when the user asks which macro or commodity factors an Indian company depends on, based on reviewed exposure mappings.

Returns every reviewed exposure of the company to a macro or commodity factor: the factor, how it reaches the company (direct or indirect, direction, lag), any stated sensitivity and mitigants, the dates it applies, and the source quote. Entries are not filtered by date, so check `valid_from` and `valid_to`. A company with none reviewed returns an empty list. To see whether a current move in crude oil or USD/INR is large enough to matter use get_company_macro_exposures.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
